label: H.R. 5408
title: Faster Labor Contracts Act

items.snippet: …that, if the parties have not reached an agreement after 90 days, either party may request mediation by the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service (FMCS).
The panel must consider specified factors, including the employer's financial prospects and employees' cost of living.

The Government Accountability Office must report to Congress regarding the average number of days between the certification or recognition of a bargaining representative and the date the initial CBA was executed.
